patch_description: Replace the exponential weighted moving average with a 2nd-order (constant-velocity) Kalman filter combined with Rauch-Tung-Striebel (RTS) backward smoothing. This yields: (1) zero-phase smoothing within the signal eliminating lag bias, (2) an adaptive process/measurement noise ratio estimated from signal SNR so the filter stiffens in quiet regions (noise suppression, fewer spurious slope reversals) and loosens in fast transitions (low lag, good tracking), and (3) O(N) computation maintaining efficiency. Output alignment (window-end indexed) is preserved so downstream code is unchanged.
